modules.name: stream_matvec_int8_16
modules.responsibility: Own command validation, FSM/counters, vector and bias staging, lane selection, stream framing, and child-module control. Vector and bias stores use synchronous handshake-qualified writes and zero-cycle asynchronous reads, with no simultaneous read/write requirement. MAC clear is a one-cycle event on the last VECTOR handshake or the last output handshake of a nonfinal tile; MAC step is exactly a MAC input handshake. They never coincide. No internal start/done ports exist; the last MAC handshake advances to EMIT, and the final output handshake completes the job.

ports.name: clk
ports.semantics: Rising-edge clock shared by all state

ports.name: rst_n
ports.semantics: Active-low synchronous state reset; suppress all top-level handshakes while low

ports.name: cfg_valid
ports.semantics: Command valid; fields remain stable while stalled

ports.name: cfg_ready
ports.semantics: High exactly in IDLE with rst_n=1; low during reset

ports.name: cfg_rows
ports.semantics: Rows captured on command handshake; reject zero or values above MAX_ROWS

ports.name: cfg_cols
ports.semantics: Columns captured on command handshake; reject zero or values above MAX_COLS

ports.name: cfg_bias_enable
ports.semantics: Captured command bias enable and bias-section presence

ports.name: cfg_relu_enable
ports.semantics: Captured command ReLU enable

ports.name: in_valid
ports.semantics: Implicit-section input payload valid

ports.name: in_ready
ports.semantics: High exactly in VECTOR, BIAS, or MAC with rst_n=1

ports.name: in_data
ports.semantics: VECTOR uses [7:0]; BIAS uses [31:0]; MAC lane j uses [8*j+7:8*j]. All unused bits are ignored.

ports.name: out_valid
ports.semantics: High exactly in EMIT or ERROR with rst_n=1

ports.name: out_ready
ports.semantics: Output acceptance qualifier

ports.name: out_data
ports.semantics: Finalizer result in valid EMIT; zero in ERROR, reset, or invalid cycles

ports.name: out_last
ports.semantics: Valid final global row or valid error response; otherwise zero

ports.name: out_error
ports.semantics: One for valid ERROR response only; otherwise zero

modules.name: int8_mac16_bank
modules.responsibility: Implement exactly 16 signed INT8 multiplication paths and 16 wrapping INT32 accumulator registers. At a rising edge, reset has priority over clear, which has priority over step; otherwise hold. No additional pipeline or handshake state.

ports.name: clk
ports.semantics: Connected to top clk

ports.name: rst_n
ports.semantics: Connected to top rst_n; synchronous low clears all 16 accumulators

ports.name: clear
ports.semantics: Top-generated tile-initialization pulse, high on the last VECTOR transfer or last nonfinal-tile output transfer; clears every accumulator at that edge

ports.name: step
ports.semantics: Top-generated rst_n && state==MAC && in_valid && in_ready; one accumulation on this edge; never coincides with clear

ports.name: vector_value
ports.semantics: Top vector_store[k] asynchronous read, stable for the step edge; broadcast to all lanes; ignored without step

ports.name: matrix_values
ports.semantics: Connected to top in_data. Lane j independently interprets [8*j+7:8*j] as signed INT8; sampled only on step.

ports.name: accumulators
ports.semantics: Lane j is signed INT32 bits [32*j+31:32*j]. Combinational view of registers; updated immediately after clear/step edges. Top selects lane j during EMIT. Each step adds the sign-extended exact signed product modulo 2^32.

modules.name: int32_bias_relu
modules.responsibility: Combinational scalar postprocessing: optional wrapping INT32 bias addition followed by optional signed ReLU. No clock, reset, enables for storage, start, done, or internal state.

ports.name: dot_value
ports.semantics: Top selects accumulator bits [32*j+31:32*j] as signed; meaningful during EMIT

ports.name: bias_value
ports.semantics: Top bias_store[j] asynchronous read when bias is enabled; top drives zero when disabled

ports.name: bias_enable
ports.semantics: Connected to captured cfg_bias_enable; zero bypasses bias_value

ports.name: relu_enable
ports.semantics: Connected to captured cfg_relu_enable

ports.name: result_value
ports.semantics: Zero-cycle combinational result: adjusted=wrap32(dot_value+bias_value) when enabled, else dot_value; output zero iff relu_enable && adjusted[31], otherwise adjusted. Top gates this onto out_data only during valid EMIT.
